text: Michigan Senate: new Mitchell/CBS Detroit poll (Oct 26–27) has El-Sayed 51–44; Kalshi odds for El-Sayed 66% → 68%.
Kalshi Senate control odds for Democrats: 65% → 67%. Polymarket House: 92% → 93%; DDHQ Senate 57% → 58%, House 79% → 80%.
Kalshi House odds for Democrats: AL-02 32% → 43%, MI-04 58% → 52%, CO-04 32% → 37%, PA-08 83% → 86%.
13 more Senate polls added from 270toWin, including Ohio (Verasight Brown +4, New River/GSG Brown +6) and Iowa (New River/GSG Turek +2, NPA Hinson +3).
Early vote passes 33.9 million ballots nationwide (Oct 28), up from 29.5 million on Oct 26.
10 new news items, including the Alaska ‘second Dan Sullivan’ report and a judge rejecting DOJ's bid to set aside 20,000 California ballots.
